title: Miyeongnan Roe Stir Fry
description: A Chinese stir fry dish featuring low-carb noodles, myeongnan roe, and a variety of vegetables.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced ginger and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add the carrots and green onions and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the low-carb noodles and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the myeongnan roe and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Season with soy sauce to taste.
Serve hot and garnish with luscious slices.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes if desired.
Check for internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) for the roe.
